blind.description: A stylized wooden billiard/pool table supported by six turned carved legs. The table features a rich reddish-brown wooden frame with brass-lined pockets and inlaid sight markers along the rails. The playing surface is covered in dark green cloth/felt, atop which rest three billiard balls (white, yellow, and red) and a single wooden cue stick with a dark handle wrap. All geometries are clean, solid, and continuous, resting stably on the floor without an added plinth or floating pieces.
blind.from_above: A vertically oriented rectangular pool table with a dark green bed framed by brown rails with six brass corner and side pockets. A cue stick rests along the left side of the table, while three balls (white, red, and yellow) are clustered near the center-lower area.
blind.height_vs_figure: The table stands around waist-height (approximately 2.5 to 3 feet tall, about half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and measures roughly 6 to 7 feet long by 3.5 feet wide.
